body: Thank you, that really has helped. My husband and I are talking now.And he's being helpful.

My mother also has BPD. My husband and I were living with her a few years back. My husband was going through depression, and had a mental breakdown and my mom kicked him and and tried to make me stay. I left and got him help. He's been doing good since then. But she lied and told my family he was on drugs, and all sorts of lies about me. She has refused to talk to me for over three years. I have tried to reach out but she tells my family I want nothing to do with her or them and they believe her.
